correctness.rationale: Given M=z_k, the other sampled value is exactly uniform on z_{k+1},...,z_N. The regression hypothesis therefore says the upper-tail mean equals z_k/2+c. Substitution into the exact tail-mean recursion yields (N-k+1)z_{k+1}=(N-k)z_k+2c, from which adjacent spacings are equal by one further recurrence step. The converse, covariance identity, and correlation follow by exact arithmetic.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The conditional expectation formula itself is elementary once the joint sampling design is known. The accepted scientific content is the converse recurrence: enforcing the canonical three-halves slope over all attainable minima forces constant successive differences. That inverse implication requires an additional argument and is not supplied by the inspected prior theorem statements.

value.rationale: Equal spacing is the defining geometry of the canonical finite-uniform serial-number population. The theorem turns that deterministic geometry into a single observable regression signature under the most basic without-replacement design. The inverse characterization is structural, and the population-size-free correlation constant supplies an interpretable consequence rather than a routine marginal moment.
